headline: Nvidia heads into Tuesday results at a 52-week low with a December Fed hike fully priced
subhead: Nvidia fell 2.0 percent Friday to 162.85 dollars, 31.9 percent below its 52-week high, the 10-year yield sits at 5.15 percent, and bitcoin is 33.0 percent off its high at 64,903.

us.text: S&P 500 fell 0.4 percent to 7,561.7 and the Nasdaq 0.9 percent to 25,136.3 Friday as AMD dropped 8.8 percent and Cisco 6.2 percent.
The 10-year yield rose to 5.15 percent as hot CPI data and Fed comments left a December rate hike fully priced.
Week ahead: Nvidia reports Tuesday, FOMC minutes land Wednesday and Anthropic is expected to price Wednesday and list Thursday.

india.text: Nifty fell 0.6 percent to 25,144.3 and Bank Nifty 0.8 percent to 61,034.1 on 13 November as October CPI hit 6.1 percent and crude rose.
FIIs net bought about Rs 5,736.6 crore in cash on 13 November while DIIs net sold about Rs 2,253.6 crore.
Rupee fell 8 paise to 94.20 per dollar on hot US inflation and higher Treasury yields; October WPI and trade data are due Monday.

global.text: Nikkei fell 0.7 percent Monday after Japan's third-quarter GDP unexpectedly shrank; the Hang Seng fell 1.6 percent Friday on a tech selloff.
Europe: the FTSE 100 rose 0.4 percent to a three-month high of 10,902.6 on insurers and oil majors, while the DAX slipped 0.1 percent.
Bitcoin hit about 62,081 dollars on 15 November after seven straight days of US spot ETF outflows, then bounced 1.2 percent to 64,903.

weekly.narrative: Jensen Huang's sudden exit as Nvidia CEO dominated the week: Nvidia fell 12.8 percent, but rotation into Apple, AMD and Broadcom still left the S&P 500 up 2.5 percent and the Nasdaq up 2.3 percent despite a Friday AI selloff. Hot US CPI and 6.5 percent annual PPI pushed the 10-year yield to 5.15 percent and left a December Fed hike fully priced, lifting the dollar to a 19-month high. That weighed on metals and crypto: gold fell 4.5 percent to a 13-month low, silver 6.1 percent and bitcoin broke below 70,000 dollars. India leaned on nine straight sessions of foreign buying and a bank rally, though the Nifty slipped to 25,144.3 on Friday after October CPI rose to 6.09 percent. Next week brings Nvidia results on 17 November, FOMC minutes on 18 November and Anthropic's expected Nasdaq debut on 19 November.
